reason: Universal Music Group N.V. Q1 2026 earnings release does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document contains detailed financial results, revenue breakdowns by segment (Recorded Music, Music Publishing, Merchandising), operational metrics, and strategic initiatives (share buyback, Spotify stake monetization), but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM or market size estimates. The company references 'a healthy industry' and 'fast-growing areas' but provides no quantified market opportunity data.
